periods.time: Late night after the victory celebration

name.zh: 一辉与史黛菈的未来约定

periods.summary: After bathing together, Ikki and Stella walk to a quiet overlook away from the celebrations. Stella reflects on how much has changed in four months at Hagun, while Ikki admits that thinking about marriage, children and becoming a father frightens him but also makes him look forward to life. Stella asks whether he will stay with her for life, and Ikki answers that his place is with her and he will never give it to anyone else. They move to kiss under the stars.
periods.cause: Stella's bath conversation about future children and her position as Vermillion's next heir makes both of them confront their coming married life after the wars end.
periods.process: They leave the noisy campus for a moonlit view over the lake. Stella recalls arriving in Japan, growing stronger and falling in love. Ikki says he cannot imagine his old life before her and admits anxiety because his own father was a poor model. He still feels more anticipation than fear and wants a future family with Stella. Stella seeks reassurance, and Ikki gives it without hesitation.
periods.outcome: Their relationship reaches a peaceful affirmation moments before Arlanz's ambush violently interrupts it.
periods.significance: Defines the personal stakes of Stella's abduction: Arlanz is not merely taking a fighter but destroying the future Ikki and Stella have just chosen together.
